description: For the person's own booking or service request with MCC Solutions: its status, time, price or quote, whether payment is due, whether it can still be canceled online, and what happens next. Needs the private link from their confirmation email (or the status_url that request_service returned); nothing is shown without it.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…; request_service returns it as status_url)

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

name: request_status
title: Where a booking or request stands
